thresholds_and_preregistered_rules.source: expanding-origin 5-session blocked OOF predictions from train dates only; each fit purges the latest 2 sessions for Y3 overlap

rule_definitions.A_full_pool_reference: all candidate rows; descriptive benchmark, uncapped
rule_definitions.B_continuation_top3: rank by train-fitted joint p(Y1), then ts_code; retain at most 3 per outcome session
rule_definitions.C_transparent_risk_score_top3: rank by p(Y1)-0.5*p(Y2)-0.5*p(Y3), then ts_code; retain at most 3
rule_definitions.D_C_plus_train_oof_down3_cap: C then abstain where joint p(Y3) exceeds train OOF q75; retain at most 3
rule_definitions.E_B_veto_streak_3plus: B with predeclared streak >=3 veto; retain at most 3
rule_definitions.F_B_abstain_compounded_weak_market: B abstains when breadth < train OOF q25 AND lagged continuation change < train OOF q25; retain at most 3
rule_definitions.G_C_abstain_model_disagreement: C abstains where range of three fixed model p(Y3) scores exceeds train OOF q80; retain at most 3

validation_2025H2.decision_rule: Decision edge requires both Y2 and Y3 paired candidate-weighted rate differences vs full pool to have 5-session block 95% intervals entirely below zero; all comparisons retain missed Y1 opportunities.

forward_2026H1.decision_rule: Decision edge requires both Y2 and Y3 paired candidate-weighted rate differences vs full pool to have 5-session block 95% intervals entirely below zero; all comparisons retain missed Y1 opportunities.

interpretation.decision_edge: NOT_DEMONSTRATED; policies are evaluated only on exposed vendor event labels and cannot establish actionable/fillable decisions
interpretation.economic_edge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; no OHLC/official limits/minute data/fees applied to observed market fills or after-cost returns
interpretation.pit: UNVERIFIED; D-1 source publication time before the 09:35 decision is not certified
interpretation.behavioral_reinforcement: BEHAVIORAL_REINFORCEMENT_NOT_IDENTIFIED; no direct investor-account, order-flow, or feedback-loop evidence
